texts.zh:
访问者：欢迎来到温科沃特。无论您是慕名已久还是故地重游，我们都非常乐意为您的花园之旅提供帮助。

谨代表园丁并根据WAPP-715号命令，请不要擅自闯入指定的温科沃特美术堂生物区。不遵守我们的指引将会降低所有相关人员的生存机会。
texts.en:
Visiting entity: welcome to Wenkwort. Whether this visit is your first or your hundredth, we are glad to facilitate your appreciation of the gardens.

On behalf of the Gardeners and in accordance with directive WAPP-715, I ask that you refrain from harsh intrusion upon the biota of planetary designate Wenkwort Artem. Failure to comply with our guidelines will diminish the survival odds of all concerned.

label.zh: 无稽之谈。我们将按照我们认为合适的方式发展我们的殖民地。
label.en: Nonsense. We'll develop our colony as we see fit.

texts.zh:
妙啊！指导方针将会立刻发送给你。

总之：WAPP-715命令允许对温科沃特花园进行负责任的、非破坏性的使用。我们非常重视保护这些世界现有的特性，但是我们不希望扼杀在<错误：帝国信标超出范围>内部的发展。

<请求紧急监控部门派遣人员到坐标19c14a05……失败。重试……失败。重试…>
texts.en:
Splendid! Guidelines will be delivered to you imminently.

In summary: Directive WAPP-715 allows for responsible, non-destructive use of the Wenkwort gardens. Great importance is attached to preserving these worlds' existing character, however we do not wish to stifle development within-<ERROR: imperial beacon out of range>.

<Requesting urgent Monitor Division dispatch to co-ordinates 19c14a05... Failed. Retrying... Failed. Retrying...>

texts.zh:
真令人失望。就这样吧。

<请求执法部门派遣人员到坐标—
<错误：无法找到帝国信标。还原至备份导航系统……成功。>
<执法部门已在途；预计在2个大周期后抵达。礼节协议暂停。>
texts.en:
How disappointing. So be it.

<Requesting Enforcer Division dispatch to co-ordinates-
<ERROR: imperial beacon could not be found. Reverting to backup navigation systems... Success.>
<Enforcer Division en route; estimated arrival 2 grand cycles. Courtesy protocols disengaged.>

texts.zh:
入侵者：你仍明显违反WAPP-715命令，命令要求位于[root.Planet.GetName]的温科沃特花园应以非破坏性方式使用。

这是你的最后一次机会，要么同意我方的指导方针，要么立即面临惩罚。
texts.en:
Intrusive entity: you remain in apparent violation of Directive WAPP-715, concerning the non-destructive use of the Wenkwort gardens at designate [root.Planet.GetName].

This is your last opportunity to accede to our guidelines, or else face swift punishment.

label.zh: 我们接受你命令中的条款。
label.en: We accept the terms of your directive.
